facts.label: E-residency
facts.text: No official e-residency programme for foreigners (a government digital identity that is not a residence permit) was found in this pass. If the country offers official digital ID or electronic signatures for residents or citizens, that is noted only where an official agency is linked.

facts.label: Official digital or government services
facts.text: Start with Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores for official digital-identity, electronic-signature or e-government services and renewals.

physical-residency.summary: Official temporary and permanent residency routes in Comoros, with presence and costs where published.

facts.label: Official residence authority
facts.text: Temporary and permanent residence routes for foreigners are administered by Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores. Read the current official route names, minimum presence and fees on that site.

facts.label: Scope
facts.text: This pattern covers official temporary and permanent residency, including published minimum presence and costs where known. It does not cover short visitor visas, which sit under Entry and Visa preparation.

citizenship.summary: Official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules in Comoros, for an Australian passport holder.

facts.label: Dual citizenship (destination rule)
facts.text: Whether the destination allows dual citizenship should be confirmed on the official nationality pages. Do not assume that a residence permit leads to citizenship, or that Australia's rule applies there.

facts.label: Citizenship by descent
facts.text: Many countries have a descent route with official documentary conditions. Confirm eligibility on the official nationality pages before planning around it.

facts.label: Official authority
facts.text: Start with Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores for official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules.

citizenship.notes: Australian law also matters: Australia allows its citizens to hold another citizenship. That does not change the destination country's own dual-citizenship rules.

sources.title: Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores
sources.supports: official citizenship or nationality authority

facts.label: Official forms and registry
facts.text: Cooperatives, mutuals, foundations, charities and associations, where they exist as official legal forms, are registered or overseen through official authorities starting at Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores.

facts.label: Official financial pages
facts.text: Official tax, banking and investment-transfer rules should be confirmed on Gouvernement de l'Union des Comores.

facts.label: Accounts and transfers
facts.text: Whether a non-resident can open a local bank account, and official tax-residency tests (often a published day-count plus other official ties), should be confirmed with the official tax authority and a licensed bank.
